The '''Trandoshan Pirate's outpost''' was the base of operations for the [[Trandoshan pirates|Trandoshan Pirates]] during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]]. During the battle, a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi Knight]] infiltrated the outpost and defeated [[Dheeb]], the pirate's leader.
